title: Attachments on a project and its worlds v1 (world.files.v1 and the world.file.* requests)
about: The reference files a maker attaches to a project or to one of its worlds (GitHub #13468): concept art, design documents and links. The list the editor's Files pane, the realm commands and the agent read; the requests that attach, link, change and detach; a part's answer and an upload's. The dev server's store and the API write the list; the editor and the realm commands write the requests. An attachment never reaches a player or a pack.
